notes.title: 📢 Dev Update: Thank You + What's Next!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44166345/6ea3f84009f4fce09c6a22289f9005c52e841185.png📢 Dev Update: Thank You + What's Next!
Hello everyone! 👋
We hope you've been enjoying your time with While Waiting – whether you’ve been uncovering hidden secrets, completing objectives, or simply... doing nothing at all.

We’re rapidly approaching 100 days since While Waiting launched! Time really flies when you’re waiting in line, waiting in traffic, waiting for that one phonecall, waiting for food… waiting for…

✨ PAX East!

We're also thrilled to share that Optillusion will be at PAX East this year! 

If you're attending, swing by our booth - we'll be showcasing:

- A first look at a special While Waiting Artbook, featuring behind-the-scenes sketches and concept art
- Exclusive merchandise, including shirts, pins, and other surprises
- Meet the team, play the game and maybe even uncover a few hints about what’s next...


We hope you can attend, and can't wait to meet some of you in person!
There’s lots more to come, but you’ll just have to wait and see what that could be - until then, come pass the time with us in Discord - we love hearing from you!
 
 – The Optillusion Team

notes.title: While Waiting - Second Update Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're excited to share some awesome improvements coming with our upcoming v1.0.2 update! Here's what you can look forward to:

New Features

Patience Meter: Many levels now include a new patience meter that depletes when you use a fidget toy. Once it’s empty, you'll have the option to skip the current level—giving you more control over your play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44166345/61ce0ea627c60d8c3bff6442a9d8380e5dfb13f5.png
Turbo Button: Need a speed boost? The turbo button lets you play levels at 1.5x or 2x speeds, perfect for those moments when you want to fast-track the fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44166345/2d4f0ccc944b4898df942ef06c0f3d4571b97c95.png
General Fixes and Improvements

 You can now pause the game or even restart a level when the notebook isn't available, ensuring you never miss a beat.
 Control improvements have been made—you can now use the enter and arrow keys to play.
 We've fixed some pesky UI issues so that level items stay behind important interface elements.

Specific level bugs have been fixed

 Level 54, "Wait for her to arrive": The player character’s odd walking behavior at the end of the level has been corrected.
 Level 93, "Wait for your turn to play mahjong": The disappearing initial tile in mahjong has been resolved.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44166345/5ddeda3d2558a812caf240157e29480183fc5cc8.png
Looking ahead, our next update will address some interaction feel issues, including adding mouse control for several levels.
We hope these changes make your gameplay smoother and more enjoyable. As always, thank you for your continued support and feedback. Stay tuned for more updates and happy gaming!

notes.title: While Waiting - First Update Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players!

Thank you for playing While Waiting! We've been closely monitoring your feedback and working hard to bring improvements, bug fixes, and  updates. Here’s what’s new in our first post-launch update:

General Fixes & Improvements
Fixed an issue where the game screen would display incorrectly if your system resolution was smaller than the resolution set by the game.
Added mouse scroll support for the level selection panel.
After finishing the True Ending, the "Start" button on the title screen will now appear as "Start?" You can retrieve your notebook by clicking it.

Level-Specific Fixes & Adjustments
Level 003 - Wait for the toaster: Fixed a bug where thrown cereals landed in the wrong position.
Level 014 - Wait for the award to be announced: Fixed a bug where the player character could clip out of the area.
Level 025 - Wait for the shooting star: The "Twinkle Twinkle Little Star" sticker can now be unlocked with the correct sequence of tapping, rather than drawing a correct sequence of lines.
Level 029 - Wait for the admission email: Fixed a bug where email items sometimes overlapped.
Level 035 - Wait for your turn to buy lunch: The "My Burgeria" sticker now unlocks after making one burger instead of five.
Level 043 - Wait to forget her: Reduced the time length and made stickers easier to obtain.
Level 054 - Wait for her to arrive: Fixed various bugs related to the popcorn machine.
Level 067 - Wait for the vicar to finish the talk: The "I read carefully" sticker is now easier to unlock, with additional hints.
Level 095 - Wait for your daughter to visit you: Increased hand movement speed; fixed a bug where hands in different split screens moved simultaneously; reduced overall level duration.
Level 098 - Wait to finish the IV drip: Reduced overall level duration.

For Content Creators: 
The music in While Waiting consists of open-source, public domain classical pieces. We've done our best to avoid tracks that could trigger copyright claims, but since classical compositions can sound very similar, some may still get muted when posting videos on YouTube or Twitch. To prevent this, we recommend streaming with the background music turned off.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We hope these changes improve your While Waiting experience. Let us know if you encounter any other issues or have suggestions — we're always listening!

Happy waiting!
